items.name: Asset swap
items.description: (Crypto Swap UI with Coin Picker): Flip the arrow to reverse the swap; tap a coin to pick another.

items.name: Heat map
items.description: (Heat Map Hover Effect): A field of grey dots that turns into a heat map under the cursor, the dots nearest the hand swelling and melting into each other; a press steps to an asterisk and the word BEND, in four palettes.

items.name: Image compare
items.description: (Image Comparison Slider): An image comparison of two pictures of one scene, an x-ray and a colour photograph: drag the line to see through the picture, or flick it and it glides to the edge.

items.name: Like
items.description: (Animated Like Button): A like button whose heart pops full and throws off a ring of particles while the count rolls like an odometer, only the digits that change turning, and a carry travelling right to left.

items.name: Signature pad
items.description: (Signature Pad): A signature pad whose ink thins as the pen speeds up and pools as it slows; pause and it says Signed, and Clear rewinds the signature stroke by stroke back to empty.

items.name: Voice note
items.description: (Hold to Record Voice Note): Hold to record a voice note: the pill opens into a live waveform, slide left to throw it away, and let go to get a clip you can play and scrub by dragging across its bars.

items.name: Eye tracker
items.description: (Eyes Following the Cursor): A soft cube with two eyes that turn to follow your cursor while it is inside the block; heading for an edge, the far eye shrinks and the pair tilts, as if a real ball had turned to look.

items.name: Dynamic island
items.description: (Dynamic Island): A black pill that holds a live activity — a timer, a call or music. Press it and it grows into the full activity on one spring, the contents blurring across; press again and it tucks back in.

items.name: Time scrubber
items.description: (Time Picker Scrubber): A time over a ruler: drag the ruler under the centre mark and the digits roll with it, or fling it and it coasts and settles on the nearest step.

items.name: Upload dropzone
items.description: (Drag and Drop File Upload): Drag a file from the tray into the box and it is drawn in, uploads with a progress bar and ticks; drop one that is over the size limit and the box refuses it, a little more indignantly each time.

items.name: Particles
items.description: (Interactive Particles Effect): A shape made of dots that scatter from your pointer and spring home behind it; press and a shockwave throws them out, and they gather again into the next shape.

items.name: Label input
items.description: (Floating Label Input): A text field whose label is its placeholder until you focus it, then lifts into the top edge with a small hop along its letters while the outline parts beneath it.

items.name: One-time code
items.description: (OTP Input): Six boxes for a verification code that are really one field, so paste, autofill and backspace all just work; each digit lands with a small swell and a wrong code shakes the row.

items.name: Generate
items.description: (AI Image Generation Loader): Press Generate and an image is made in front of you the way a generated one arrives — broad shapes first and fine detail last — under a glassy surface that settles as it finishes.

items.name: Step player
items.description: (Step Progress Indicator): A row of dots and a play button: the current step stretches into a bar that fills while it runs, then eases over to the next dot with a small wave through the ones it passes.

items.name: Todo tower
items.description: (Physics To-Do List): A to-do list stacked like bricks under real physics: check one off or pull one out and the rest come down after it, and a card left hanging off the edge tips over.

items.name: Image accordion
items.description: (Image Accordion Gallery): A row of photographs in a fixed width; hover one and it opens while its neighbours give way on a falloff, so the whole row leans toward your pointer.

items.name: Glass bubble
items.description: (Liquid Glass Refraction Effect): A square picture and a ball of glass you drag over it. The picture is the only content; the bubble is the whole block.

items.name: Action node
items.description: (Automation Node Card): A card for one step of an automation, with its controls folded into the corner until you want them.

items.name: Magnetic select
items.description: (Magnetic Chip Select): A cluster of options set close enough together to be in each other's way, and a selection that behaves like a magnet rather than a highlight: the one you press swells and takes the ink, and the rest are shoved radially out of its way — hardest next to it, barely at all at the edges.

items.name: Slide to confirm
items.description: (Slide to Confirm Button): A handle you push across a track. It follows the finger exactly, and past the mark it takes over and finishes the journey itself.

items.name: Assignees
items.description: (Assignee Picker with Avatars): A pill that opens a list, and fills up with faces as you assign them. One, two, four — the pill grows to hold them and they overlap into a stack rather than a row. It was called "People picker", which named the widget rather than the job. What this is FOR is putting names against a thing — assigning a task, adding contributors — and the pill is the answer to "who is on this".

items.name: Checklist
items.description: (Animated Checklist): Three tasks, and the only thing this block does is cross one out.

items.name: Carousel
items.description: (3D Card Carousel): Cards on a turntable that drift at rest, give under the pointer, and can be swiped round.

items.name: Palette
items.description: (Color Palette Generator): Three to five colours that go together, and a button that finds you another set.

items.name: Aspect ratio
items.description: (Aspect Ratio Crop Selector): A picture and a segmented control that crops it to 4:3, 1:1 or 3:4, keeping the same area in every shape so it reads as a crop rather than a resize.

items.name: Tilt card
items.description: (3D Tilt Card Hover Effect): A photo card that sinks under your pointer instead of rising to meet it, with a shadow at the point you press and light catching the far edge.

items.name: Now playing
items.description: (Music Player Widget): A now-playing bar that opens into a full player and folds back, every size and corner driven by one number so it moves as a single object.

items.name: Dragging ball
items.description: (Draggable Squishy Ball): One circle, and the only thing it does is follow your finger. What makes it worth a card is the

items.name: Search
items.description: (Expanding Search Bar): A search icon that becomes a search field as one object — the magnifier travels into place while the field opens around it, rather than one fading out for the other.

items.name: Pull to refresh
items.description: (Pull to Refresh): Pull the card down and it stretches with you; past the line it commits, springs back with a little overshoot and refreshes the balance.

items.name: Escape button
items.description: (Runaway Button): Two components whose behaviour is the joke. The material stays as quiet as everything else on this bench — no confetti, no exclamation marks, no sound. If the decoration is doing the work then the interaction is not.

items.name: Slosh slider
items.description: (Liquid Fill Slider): A slider whose value has mass. The handle is rigid — it is under your finger and anything under a finger that lags it is broken. The

items.name: Create menu
items.description: (Gooey Create Menu): Three metaball studies: a toggle, a reorderable list, and a create menu.

items.name: Reorder list
items.description: (Drag to Reorder List): Three metaball studies: a toggle, a reorderable list, and a create menu.

items.name: Canvas toolbar
items.description: (Floating Canvas Toolbar): A floating tool bar, the kind every canvas app grows. No title, no chip — it is a bar, and a bar is the whole component. The shape slot keeps whichever shape you last chose, so the bar teaches you your own habit instead of resetting to a default every time. That is the small thing these get wrong most often.

items.name: Radial menu
items.description: (Radial Menu): A floating tool bar, the kind every canvas app grows. No title, no chip — it is a bar, and a bar is the whole component. The shape slot keeps whichever shape you last chose, so the bar teaches you your own habit instead of resetting to a default every time. That is the small thing these get wrong most often.

items.name: Drag stepper
items.description: (Number Stepper with Drag): Tap for one, hold to sweep. A stepper is precise and slow; a slider is fast and vague. Almost every product picks one and makes the other job painful. This is both, on the same control, chosen by how long you hold it — so the coarse move never costs you the fine one.

items.name: Inline confirm
items.description: (Inline Delete Confirmation): A floating tool bar, the kind every canvas app grows. No title, no chip — it is a bar, and a bar is the whole component. The shape slot keeps whichever shape you last chose, so the bar teaches you your own habit instead of resetting to a default every time. That is the small thing these get wrong most often.

items.name: Notify
items.description: (Notify Me Button): The component is the button, alone in the middle of its stage. It used to raise a stack of draggable toasts, which made the study about the toasts rather than the button. A press does two things. The bell swings on a damped oscillation rather than a single shake — each pass smaller than the last, which is what a struck bell actually does. And the button stays down: it fills, and its label changes to the promise it just made. The confirmation is the control itself, so there is nothing to read and nothing to dismiss. Press it again to call the promise off. The label swap would jolt the pill from one width to another, so the two labels are stacked out of flow and the pill is given the width of whichever one is showing. It grows into its answer instead of snapping to it.

items.name: Icon bar
items.description: (Animated Tab Bar): Same two phase indicator as the segmented pill: the leading edge runs ahead, the pill dilates across both slots, then the trailing edge catches up and overshoots on landing.

items.name: Magnifying dock
items.description: (macOS Magnifying Dock): Scale falls off with distance from the cursor rather than applying only to the hovered item, which is what stops it reading as a row of buttons that happen to grow.

items.name: Progress ticks
items.description: (Tick Slider): A row of ticks that is also the control: scrub along it to preview a value, with the number and the difference from where you started shown only while you scrub.

items.name: Wheel
items.description: (Circular Dial Slider): A draggable ring of ticks with a reading in the middle; the lit band grows with a wave along its ticks and a brighter head leading it.

items.name: Command bar
items.description: (Command Bar): A command bar whose button fuses into the field as it opens, with a snap at the neck, then slides back out when you are done.

items.name: Selection list
items.description: (Multi-Select List): A list of people you select with a tap; the rows lift as they are chosen and a button grows out from the middle once there is something to act on.

items.name: Range dial
items.description: (Circular Range Slider): Same tick language as the humidity wheel, but the value is a range rather than a point, so the ticks fill between the two handles and the drag picks whichever handle is nearer.

items.name: Liquid toggle
items.description: (Liquid Toggle Switch): Three metaball studies: a toggle, a reorderable list, and a create menu.

items.name: Usage forecast
items.description: (Pro): A billing period usage chart with a forecast cone and a draggable budget that dates the crossing.

items.name: MRR waterfall
items.description: (Pro): An MRR bridge whose floating bars morph by period and open the accounts behind each move.

items.name: Webhooks
items.description: (Pro): A webhooks console with delivery history, a payload inspector and retries that roll the rate.

items.name: Roles and permissions
items.description: (Pro): A permissions matrix with group toggles that ripple, role duplication and a review bar.

items.name: Metric explorer
items.description: (Pro): KPI cards that open into a scrubbable chart and morph between metrics and ranges.

items.name: Activity terrain
items.description: (Pro): A 3D terrain of hourly activity you can orbit, zoom, fly into and flatten into a heatmap.

items.name: Revenue globe
items.description: (Pro): A dotted globe where live payments arc home to headquarters, with a replayable day.

items.name: Customer galaxy
items.description: (Pro): 2,400 accounts as a drifting galaxy that spirals into clusters by plan, region or health.

items.name: Semantic zoom
items.description: (Pro): An infinite-zoom map of a company that reveals teams, projects, tasks and people as you fly in.

items.name: Layout morph
items.description: (Pro): A 24 card gallery that flies between grid, masonry, list, fan, carousel and a 3D helix.

items.name: Agent run
items.description: (Pro): A live AI agent run: steps stream in, tool calls expand, a diff waits for approval, and it all folds into a result.

items.name: Week calendar
items.description: (Pro): A week calendar where you drag to create, move, and resize events, with color coded calendars, day and agenda views, and swipes on phones.

items.name: Scroll story
items.description: (Pro): A feature section where scrolling the copy drives a pinned product view through each step.

items.name: Spotlight grid
items.description: (Pro): A feature grid where light follows the pointer, cards play live demos, and a click morphs a card into its detail.

items.name: Invite people
items.description: (Pro): Invite teammates with roles, bulk paste validation, a seat meter, and avatars that fly into a pending list.

items.name: Cart drawer
items.description: (Pro): Products fly into the cart, counts roll, and a drawer handles quantities, shipping progress, and checkout.

items.name: Pricing calculator
items.description: (Pro): A seat slider and billing toggle drive plan cards with rolling prices and a moving recommended badge.

items.name: AI chat
items.description: (Pro): A complete AI chat with streamed markdown answers, folding reasoning, tool chips, citations, and a model switcher.

items.name: Checkout summary
items.description: (Pro): An order summary with a promo code that becomes a chip, discount and tax lines, and pay button states.

items.name: Settings command
items.description: (Pro): Workspace settings where a search field grows into a palette that flies you to any setting.

items.name: Usage billing
items.description: (Pro): A usage based billing dashboard with a projected spend line, meters against limits, alerts, and an upgrade that morphs into a confirm sheet.

items.name: AI side panel
items.description: (Pro): An assistant docked beside a page that streams answers, pulls context chips from it, and applies changes with a highlight.

items.name: KPI drilldown
items.description: (Pro): KPI cards that expand into a full detail chart with period comparison and a breakdown table, then fold back.

items.name: Feature bento
items.description: (Pro): A six cell feature bento where small, real product UI acts each feature out on hover.

items.name: Product listing
items.description: (Pro): A storefront grid with price, color and size filters, a sort menu, hover photo swaps, and quick add with a size row.

items.name: Product detail
items.description: (Pro): A product page with a swipeable gallery, finish and size variants, add to bag that confirms in place, shipping, a reviews summary, and details.

items.name: Hero signup
items.description: (Pro): A full screen waitlist hero on a soft, drifting mesh gradient: the email field validates as you type and its button grows into the confirmation with your place in line.

items.name: Search results
items.description: (Pro): A faceted workspace search page with suggestions, facet counts that follow the query, filter chips, mixed doc, person and file results with highlighted matches, a gliding keyboard cursor and a preview pane.

items.name: Market terminal
items.description: (Pro): A trading terminal with a canvas candlestick chart, volume, moving averages, crosshair OHLC readout, wheel, drag and pinch zoom, a live watchlist with sparklines and flashing prices, and a market and limit order ticket.

items.name: Budget variance
items.description: (Pro): Budget against actual operating spend by department as aligned bullet charts, with favorable and unfavorable variance, a month, quarter and year to date switch that springs every bar, in-place drill-down into budget lines, and a total row.

items.name: Choropleth explorer
items.description: (Pro): A filled-region map that shades every state or region by revenue, growth or penetration on a stepped scale, with a country switch (United States, Canada, Brazil, United Kingdom, France, Germany, Italy, Australia), a hoverable legend, a synced ranked list and a camera zoom into local detail.

items.name: Small multiples
items.description: (Pro): A trellis of small line charts that reads as one chart, with a synced crosshair, a shared or independent y scale that springs the axes, sorting with a FLIP reorder, a ghost of the overall total behind every panel and dimming for flat trends.

items.name: Connected scatter
items.description: (Pro): A connected scatterplot of monthly CAC against LTV where the path draws itself in, a scrubber moves a head along the curve, and a channel switch morphs the path against a shaded 3x target line.

items.name: Line replay
items.description: (Pro): A time replay line chart that draws a day of traffic with a moving playhead, a value label on the tip, a scrubber, speed control and key moments annotated as the playhead passes them.
